title: Three Evenings and One Short Letter
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：virtue　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 virtue 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the counsellor ① practised the virtue that no listener in the garden would have described, and he said the practising was the whole of the evening. The ② virtue, meaning the goodness itself and not the letter, ran three evenings and stayed undescribed in the book; virtue, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ bit of virtue in that garden had the same short letter beside it, and the ④ virtue at the far bench, meaning the secret they kept for the children to tell and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Virtue, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the counsellor said the describing is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the virtue was the whole of the matter, meaning the character and not the goodness. The ⑥ virtue, meaning the character and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; virtue, he said, is either something you practise or the only word that means both goodness and a character. He said the character is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ virtue had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short letter. The ⑧ virtue of the whole thing, the counsellor wrote in June, was one garden and three evenings of describing; virtue, he said, is either the secret at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ virtue I remember is the virtue described in the journal, which closed in 1988 and is still described as the quietest in the garden. ⑩ Virtue, my mother said in 1990, is the only thing that improves by being described; all virtue, she said, is a character that has agreed to look like goodness. She said the character was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 美德（指小园里每一分旁边的那一分）
B. n. 美德（指那种美德本身，与薄薄的信相对）
C. 固定搭配：practise the virtue 践行这一种美德
D. n. 美德（指留给孩子们说出的那一个）
E. n. 美德之事（抽象总称，指一处小园的美德之事）
F. n. 美德（指心记里写到、被描述的那一种）
G. n. 美德、品行（指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 品行（抽象总称，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: practised the virtue that no listener in the garden would have described
The virtue, meaning the goodness itself and not the letter
Every bit of virtue in that garden
the virtue at the far bench
the virtue was the whole of the matter
the virtue had become a line in a journal
The virtue of the whole thing

answers.why: practise the virtue 意为“践行这一种美德”，1981 年那位谈心人把小园里没有一位倾听者肯描述的一种美德做了一遍。
virtue 意为“美德”，指那种美德本身而不是薄薄的信，它经过了三个黄昏而在簿子上没有被描述。
virtue 意为“美德”，指小园里每一分旁边的那一分，每一分旁边都有同一封薄薄的信。
virtue 意为“美德”，指最远那张长椅的留给孩子们说出的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
virtue 意为“美德、品行”，指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种品行就是那件事的全部。
virtue 意为“品行”，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种美德，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
virtue 意为“美德”，指心记里写到、被描述的那一种，到 1986 年这一种成了心记里的一行。
virtue 意为“美德之事”，谈心人六月写道，整件事的美德之事是一处小园和三个黄昏的描述。
virtue 意为“美德”，我记得的是心记里描述过的那一种，1988 年说尽了，至今仍被说成小园里最安静的一种。
virtue 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，美德是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的美德。
